en.hubeali: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘We ate with Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so they came with camel meat. So we thought it is from his<sup>asws</sup> house. So we ate, then they came with bowl of milk. So we drank from it. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Drink, O Abu Muhammad!’ So I tasted it, and I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>, milk!’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is the nature’. Then they came to us with dates, so we ate it’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Muhammad ibn Ali from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu Hashim from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir who has said the following: “

We ate with abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam. There was meat of camel (or sheep) and I thought it was from his house. We ate, and then bowls of milk were brought. He (the Imam) drank from it and said to me, ‘O abu Muhammad drink.’ I tasted it and asked, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, is it milk?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is al- Fitrah (nature, seed).’ Then dates were brought and we ate.’”
